device.description: 10-bit 200 kSPS micropower SAR ADC with synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7829.pdf (SLAS388) p.3-4 specifications (VCC operating range, VIH, straight binary), p.5 pin description and terminal functions, p.14 digital interface (Figure 37), p.15 Table 1 timing and data format

pages: p.3 (VIH 2.0-5.5 V), p.4 (VCC 2.7-3.6 V, 2.0-2.7 V and 3.6-5.25 V, data format), p.5 (pins), p.14 (signal levels, Figure 37), p.15 (Table 1 timing, frame description, data format)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (11 clocks per Table 1, 10 per the spec table; not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the first two DCLOCK edges, then the null bit, then B9..B0; what follows B0 with CS still low is not shown for the ADS7826 (the model outputs zeros, as the ADS7829's LSB-first-then-zeros would for the 0 V code)
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
vcc 2.0-5.25 V spans the three VCC rows of the spec table (2.0-2.7 V with reduced clock rate)
variants: ADS7829 (12-bit) and ADS7827 (8-bit) share the datasheet and pinout: own spec files.
